Here is a line-by-line transcription of the Latin baptismal registry from 1862 shown in `image_1e6b00.png`.

Please note that nineteenth-century parish registers heavily use standard Latin abbreviations (such as *filius/filia* for son/daughter, *sponsbus/sponsoribus* for sponsors/godparents, and *Joannis* for John). The transcription below preserves the spelling and abbreviations written by the parish priest (Joannes Quinlan, P.P.).

---

## Left Page (June – August 1862)

### **1862**

* **Die 22da Junii** – Margarita filia Joannis Sheehan et Helenae Sullivan, sponsbus Jacobo Rush et Brigida Walsh. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 28th** Jacobus filius Thomae Kelly et Joannae Mulqueen Sponsbus Joanne Mulqueen et Brigida Shanahan. J. Quinlan P.P.
* **" 29th** Maria filia Joannis Kennedy et Mariae Hane Sponsbus Gulielmo Molony et Maria Costelloe. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Die 3tia Julii** – Margarita filia Edwardi Kennedy et Brigida Whelan sponsbus Patricio Kelly et Brigida Kennedy – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** – Patricius filius Rogeri Ryan et Mariae Flynn, Sponsbus Jacobo Sweeny et Maria Sweeny – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 13th** Patricius filius Jacobi Flatie et Mariae Sullivan, Sponsbus Gulielmo Nunan et Christina Nunan – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** – Joannes filius Joannis Connors et Honoria Flaherty Sponsbus Patricio Power et Anna Cellars – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 24th** Honoria filia Joannis Lyons et Catherinae Hinane Sponsbus Michaele Lyons et Catherinae Hinane. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 27th** Maria filia Laurentii Conway et Brigida Moriarty Sponsbus Joanne Kennedy et Helena Hogan – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** Ellena filia Jacobi Canty et Catherinae Sexton Sponsbus Patricio Sexton et Maria Bourke. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** Joannes filius Jacobi Sheahy et Catherinae Connell Sponsbus Jacobo Burns et Margarita Hourigan. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Augustii 10mo die** – Maria filia Danielis Carmody et Mariae Conway Sponsbus Jacobo Conway et Margarita Lacey – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 12th die** – Patricius filius Joannis Sculley et Ellenae See Sponsbus Patricio See et Brigida See Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 14th die** Georgius filius Gulielmi Bourke et Mariae Clifford Sponsbus Joanne Dwyer et Johanna Clifford. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 15th die** – Brigida filia Henrici Widnes et Mariae Ragan Sponsbus Joanne Morrissey et Ellena O'Brien – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** Joannes filius Joannis Boyle et Catherinae Flynn Sponsbus Thoma Flynn et Catherinae Quillinan – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **" 24th** Gulielmus filius Jacobi Reagan et Mariae Hayes – Sponsbus Patricio Hogan et Maria Hogan, Joannes Quinlan P.P.

* **Die 10mo** Joannes filius Joannis Dalton et Catherinae Keogan sponsbus Cornelio Canty et Honoria Canty. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Die 11mo** Thomas filius Laurentii Madden et Mariae Neville sponsbus Jacobo Mulvihill et Maria Madden. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** Michael filius ejusdem Laurentii Madden et Mariae Neville Sponsbus Michael Hanrahan et Catherinae Toomey – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Die 14to** Redmundus filius Patricii Scanlan et Mariae Sheehy Sponsbus Joanne Costelloe et Janeta Sheehy. Joannes Quinlan P.P.

* **Die 21mo** Hellena filia Joannis Cusack et Catherinae Brandon Spon – Gulielmo Gavin et Maria Neville – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** – Hellena filia Patricii Bourke et Hellenae Toras (?) Spon – Joanne Duggan et Hellena Bourke – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Die 26to** Jacobus filius Patricii Kelly et Brigidae Perrile, Sponbus Michael Perrile et Alicia Perrile. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **die 28th** – Gulielmus filius Timothei Shanahan et Johanna Walsh. Sponsbus Patricio Shanahan et Maria Shanahan – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** – Margarita filia Patricii Cahty et Mariae Walsh – Spons Thoma Molony et Margarita Dempsey. Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Eodem die** – Michael filius Joannis Connors et Mariae Fitzgerald Spons – Joanne Denneen et Sarah Fitzgerald – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
* **Die 2da Octobris** – Samuel Brown filius Gulielmi Brown et Mariae Keily – Spons – Michaele Roche et Maria O'Brien – Joannes Quinlan P.P.
